mechanics.definition: 同一次入口内，按规则移除、替换或保留已结算内容，再通过移动或补入形成下一盘并重复结算，直到继续条件不成立。

conditional_packages.when: 存在step_multiplier_rule并密封same_depth_multiplier_randomness；同深度仍随机时评分依赖残差，depth到倍率状态完全确定时只派生

evidence_signatures: one paid entry contains ordered settlement steps with explicit cascade indexes
each next board is reproducible from resolved cells, retained cells and newly inserted cells
refill_partition_rule is explicitly investigated; when stable reel or region partitions exist it seals partition order and maps every newly inserted valid cell to exactly one partition
exclusions: a new paid spin or independent respin redraws the board
presentation-only win animations with no subsequent settlement
a feature counter advances without board evolution
